quests.title: The Window Above Carramar
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Carramar and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Homebush
quests.blurb: Five in the morning, in the dark, and the bloke with the bay next to mine has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$76 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Pendle Hill
quests.blurb: The clock on this platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Go and find out who set it, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Toongabbie, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Narara
quests.blurb: There is a dog that meets the 5:40 at Narara every weekday and has done for months, and nobody gets off for it. I have decided this is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Lakemba
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races and someone is beating it. Not by much and not by luck. Ride the run they ride, watch what they watch, and tell me what they know that I do not.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$66 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Lindfield
quests.blurb: The last one through Lindfield carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Roseville, photograph what the platform looks like with nobody on it, and come back and tell me it is still there.

steps.label: ride the late one to Roseville
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Wollstonecraft Tap-Off
quests.blurb: Somebody taps on at Wollstonecraft every morning and never taps off. Same card. I want you to ride the run they ride and find where a person can get off this network without a gate seeing them.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph the gap before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Macquarie Park Order
quests.blurb: I do two hundred coffees between six and nine and I know every one of them by the walk. One of my regulars stopped coming. Take a coffee to where they work and find out whether they are dead or just went to the other place.

steps.label: order one at the Macquarie Park kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $71 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Cheltenham
quests.blurb: The board at Cheltenham says four minutes. It has said four minutes for as long as anyone can remember and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand there. Time it. Bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Hawkesbury River
quests.blurb: Everything anyone has ever left on a train ends up in a room, and the room is full. Most of it nobody wants. One of them somebody wants very badly and has not come to ask. Find out why.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$46 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Campbelltown
quests.blurb: There is a sign and the sign is not enforced by anybody, which makes it the only law in this city that runs on shame. Somebody has stopped feeling it. Ride the Campbelltown run and deal with it.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Auburn Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier in this city has a route that is not on any map and mine goes through Auburn. They have started locking one end of it. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs me
$50, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Punchbowl
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession. Find them before a rail grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Revesby Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar for nineteen years and then stopped, and nobody in this suburb will tell me why. You are not from here, which makes you the only person who can ask.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Liverpool
quests.blurb: Two hundred bays, two hundred and forty cars, and one of them has not moved since March. It has a ticket on it from March. I have watched people give up and park on the grass because of it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$50 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Sydenham
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things. Last week I painted over something good and I have been sick about it since. There is another one two streets from Sydenham. Photograph it before Thursday.

steps.label: the wall, before Thursday
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Killara
quests.blurb: I drive past the same view eleven times a shift and I have never once stopped at it. You have got legs and no timetable. Go up there and photograph what I have been driving past for six years.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$65, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Hurstville
quests.blurb: I got done for something I did not do at Hurstville and the form says I need evidence, and the evidence is a sign that is not where the sign is supposed to be. Go and photograph the sign not being there.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Wansey Road
quests.blurb: There is a metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Wansey Road and it has been dead for eleven years. It is not dead now. I need someone to stand near it and stop a man with a whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Norwest
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio. Somebody has been taking things and it is not one of mine, which means it is somebody who knows our roster. Ride in on the late one and watch the door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$72 of what they took, back
